description: An invite link for ONE player who is not on Reliquary yet, to bring them into the current user's trade circle. Relay `url` and `sentence` for the user to send (WhatsApp, a message): the sentence counts the cards the user's handle publishes and never names one. The link is single use and lasts 30 days: the first account made through it gets a circle request from the user waiting, which the new player accepts. A player already on Reliquary is added by handle (add_friend) instead. Needs the user's own handle (set_handle) and a free place in the plan's circle; a few links a day.
name: invite_friend
title: Invite friend
